output.summary: A trailing herbaceous vine found on pantropical and subtropical upper beaches, cliffs and dunes. It forms leafy mats, tolerates salt and produces buoyant seeds carried by ocean currents. Young seeds and pods are edible, especially after boiling, and the flowers can be made into a spice.
